summary: Visual/functional regression testing of the CLS/LCP performance batch: static hero rendering (no fade-in), self-hosted fonts, PNG->WebP conversions, image width/height attrs, and logo aspect ratios across Home, System, and all 4 product pages. All checks passed - no regressions found.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' - React JSX requires camelCase fetchPriority instead of lowercase fetchpriority on tags. Purely a console warning, no functional/visual impact observed.

action_items: Optional: rename fetchpriority -> fetchPriority on tags in Home.jsx and ProductHero.jsx to silence React console warning (cosmetic, no functional impact).
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx Hero() and ProductHero.jsx: entrance animations correctly removed from headline/subhead/CTA/image - confirmed rendered immediately in first screenshot after navigation, no fade-in delay observed.

fonts.css @font-face declarations correctly resolve; all 3 woff2 files (Manrope, Zalando Sans SemiExpanded, JetBrains Mono) load with zero 404s; computed font-family confirmed correct on headline (Zalando Sans SemiExpanded), body (Manrope), and mono/eyebrow (JetBrains Mono) elements.
index.html confirmed clean of fonts.googleapis.com and api.fontshare.com references; page HTML content also has zero occurrences of 'fontshare'/'googleapis' strings.
WebP conversions (xolab-trace/block/edge, xofit mobile-screen-1/2/3, frame-tryon) all load successfully with zero broken images or 404s across all 3 xoFit tabs and the xoLab equipment section.

Logo width/height attributes verified across Navbar, Footer, Home product cards, System page, and EyeCare4Kids partner logo - all render at correct aspect ratio (natural aspect matches displayed aspect), no stretching/squishing observed.
Dark/light theme toggle verified working on xoLab page - html class toggles to 'lenis dark', logo variants (light/dark SVG) swap correctly with no broken images during the swap.
